messages.settings.drive.privacyEncryption: Configuration is encrypted on your device before upload; the cloud stores an encrypted file.
messages.settings.drive.privacyStorage: Only the application-data area of your Google Drive is accessed, not your regular Drive files.
messages.settings.drive.privacyAuthorization: Temporary authorization caches are cleared when sync finishes or is canceled.
messages.settings.drive.privacyExcluded: Your wordbook, chat history, and usage statistics are excluded from configuration sync.
messages.settings.drive.description: Save your complete configuration to your own Google Drive in encrypted form and restore it on other devices; includes API keys, OAuth tokens, authentication headers, custom request bodies, and authentication parameters in URLs, but excludes your wordbook, chat history, and usage statistics.
messages.settings.drive.differences: {count} differences. Private and custom content is hidden.
messages.settings.drive.selectedAccount: Sync uses the account you selected in Google.
messages.settings.drive.firstTitle: Save this device’s configuration to Drive
messages.settings.drive.firstDescription: This account has no sync file yet. After saving, you can restore it on another device.
messages.settings.drive.identicalDescription: No settings need replacing. You can finish this sync.
messages.settings.drive.chooseTitle: What would you like to do?
messages.settings.drive.firstRestoreDescription: A cloud configuration exists. Restore it to this device, or save this device’s configuration.
messages.settings.drive.returningDescription: Changes were compared with the last sync. Merge them, or use one side’s complete configuration.
messages.settings.drive.downloadDescription: Replace this device’s settings and credentials with the configuration in Google Drive.
messages.settings.drive.uploadDescription: Save this device’s settings and credentials to Google Drive, replacing the existing cloud configuration.
messages.settings.drive.mergeDescription: One-sided changes are kept automatically. For conflicts, choose the device or cloud version.
messages.settings.drive.mergeReady: Ready to sync changes on both sides
messages.settings.drive.privateHint: Keys, addresses, and custom content are hidden; related settings are kept as a group.
messages.settings.drive.firstMergeDescription: For the first merge, choose the device or cloud version for each different setting.
messages.settings.drive.mergeQuestion: Want to keep selected changes from both sides?
messages.settings.drive.title: Google Drive configuration sync

legacy.把完整配置加密保存到自己的 Google 云盘，在其他设备恢复。: Encrypt your complete configuration in your own Google Drive and restore it on another device.
legacy.包含API Key、OAuth Token、鉴权请求头、自定义请求体及URL中的: Includes API keys, OAuth tokens, authentication headers, custom request bodies, and authentication parameters in URLs. Excludes wordbooks, conversations, and usage statistics.
legacy.云端还没有同步文件。本次将创建加密的完整配置快照。: There is no cloud file yet. This will create an encrypted complete configuration snapshot.
legacy.这是本机首次同步此账号，请明确选择同步方向。下载会替换本机的配置及凭据。: This device has no sync baseline for this account. Choose a direction. Downloading replaces local configuration and credentials.
legacy.本机完整配置及凭据将替换云端快照。: The complete device configuration and credentials will replace the cloud snapshot.
legacy.云端完整配置及凭据将替换本机设置。: The complete cloud configuration and credentials will replace device settings.
legacy.未冲突的修改已自动选择；请确认每项冲突的保留方向。: Changes without conflicts are selected automatically. Choose a version for each conflict.
legacy.Google Drive 同步目前支持 Chrome 扩展；其他浏览器可使用下方: Google Drive sync currently supports the Chrome extension. Other browsers can use the complete data backup below.
legacy.Google Drive 同步需要 Chrome 扩展后台；当前环境可使用完整数: Google Drive sync requires a Chrome extension background. Use complete data backups in this environment.
legacy.本机配置已变化，请重新生成同步预览。: Device settings changed. Generate a new sync preview.
legacy.云端配置已变化，请重新生成同步预览。: The cloud configuration changed. Generate a new sync preview.
legacy.同步未完成，请重试。: Sync did not complete. Try again.
legacy.同步文件无法解密或已损坏；请检查云端备份，本机配置未被修改。: The sync file cannot be decrypted or is damaged. Check the cloud backup; device settings have not changed.
legacy.Google 授权未完成，请点击同步按钮后重试。: Google authorization was not completed. Click the sync button to retry.
legacy.Google 未返回有效授权，请点击同步按钮重试。: Google did not return valid authorization. Click the sync button to retry.
legacy.未允许 Google Drive 配置数据权限，请重新同步并在 Google 授: Google Drive configuration access was not allowed. Sync again and allow configuration data access on the Google consent page.
legacy.Google 账号响应无效，请重新同步。: Google returned invalid account information. Sync again.
legacy.本次同步授权已结束，请重新生成预览。: Authorization for this sync has ended. Generate a new preview.
legacy.同步预览已失效，请重新生成。: Sync preview expired. Generate a new preview.
legacy.同步口令已修改，请重新生成预览。: Encryption settings changed. Generate a new preview.
legacy.Google 账号已切换，请重新生成同步预览。: Google account changed. Generate a new sync preview.
legacy.本机保存和恢复失败，请重新打开设置检查配置；云端保留本次加密快照。: Saving and restoring device settings failed. Reopen settings and check them; the encrypted snapshot remains in the cloud.
legacy.本机保存失败，已恢复原配置；请重新预览后重试。: Saving device settings failed. Original settings restored. Generate a new preview to retry.
legacy.另一个设置页面正在确认同步，请先完成或取消该页面的预览。: Another settings page has a sync preview open. Complete or cancel it there first.
legacy.同步预览属于其他页面或已失效，请在原设置页面继续。: This sync preview belongs to another page or is no longer valid. Continue in the original settings page.
legacy.扩展后台暂时不可用，请重新打开设置后重试。: Extension background unavailable. Reopen settings and retry.
legacy.同步请求未完成，请重试。: Sync request did not complete. Try again.
legacy.云端文件不包含完整的配置和凭据快照: Cloud file is not a complete configuration and credential snapshot.
legacy.同步配置引用了不存在的自定义服务，请重新预览并选择完整连接配置。: Configuration references a missing custom service. Generate a new preview and select a complete connection group.
legacy.请为每个冲突选择本机或云端配置: Choose the device or cloud version for every conflict.
legacy.云端配置已变化，请重新生成预览。: Cloud configuration changed. Generate a new preview.
legacy.Google Drive 拒绝访问，请检查授权范围、测试用户及 API 配额。: Google Drive denied access. Check permissions, test users, and API quota.
legacy.Google Drive 网络请求失败或响应无效，请检查网络后重试。: Google Drive request failed or returned an invalid response. Check your connection and retry.
legacy.发现多个同名同步文件，请先在 Google Drive 应用管理中清理重复数据。: Duplicate sync files found. Remove duplicate data in Google Drive app management first.
legacy.同步文件过大，请使用完整数据备份。: Sync file is too large. Use a complete data backup.
legacy.无法读取同步文件。: Unable to read the sync file.
legacy.读取期间云端配置已变化，请重试。: Cloud configuration changed while reading. Try again.
legacy.只允许上传本地加密后的配置。: Only locally encrypted configuration can be uploaded.
legacy.只允许上传大小有效的加密配置。: Only encrypted configuration within the size limit can be uploaded.
legacy.当前开发版扩展 ID 与 Google OAuth 客户端不匹配，请按维护者指南: Development extension ID does not match the OAuth client. Follow the maintainer guide to set its public key or create a development client.
legacy.扩展缺少 Google Drive 应用数据授权范围，请重新构建。: Extension is missing the Google Drive app-data scope. Rebuild it.
legacy.无法读取 Google 账号，请检查网络后重试。: Unable to read the Google account. Check your connection and retry.
legacy.Google Drive 同步仅允许从扩展设置页面操作。: Google Drive sync is only available from extension settings.
legacy.同步未完成，请检查网络和配置存储后重新预览。: Sync did not complete. Check your network and configuration storage, then generate a new preview.
legacy.显示悬停、划词、图片、视频和文档等快捷入口。: Show shortcuts for hover, selection, images, video and documents.
legacy.同步配置过大，请减少自定义设置后重试: Sync configuration exceeds 20 MiB. Reduce custom settings or use a complete data backup.
